description_en: Obtain online agent information data under real-time monitoring. Support queries by instance, time range, agent, and department group
description_zh: 获取在线监控下在线坐席信息数据。支持实例、时间区间、坐席、部门分组查询
name: GetOnlineSeatInformation

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh:
AICCS实例ID。
您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Start date UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始日期时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: End date UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.
parameters.help_zh: 结束日期时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: Page size. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。取值大于0，默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Current page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页。取值大于0，默认值：1
parameters.name: current_page
